_comment: OpenShell gateway config the NemoClaw CLI resolves under ~/.config/openshell/. Reconstructed from /root/.config/openshell/active_gateway + gateways/nemoclaw/metadata.json + last_sandbox. The conduct path uses ONLY this host :8080 L7 relay (the in-sandbox :18789 dashboard gateway is NOT required for conducts). No secrets — auth_mode is plaintext on loopback.
